purpose: Check whether a pause guard alone or a simple observed-run backoff explains any improvement attributed to whole-schedule training.
guarded_C2: all original 64 full C2 rules, occupied pauses capped at 60, free pauses capped at 75/90/120 seconds; parameters selected only on original128
backoff: free interval 15/30/45/60 until observed run reaches 60/300/900/3600 seconds, then 75/90/120; occupied interval 30/45/60; 144 causal rules, selected only on original128
selection: original strict F/O/M60 constraints and minimum calls; fallback fixed60
fresh_check: same frozen 512-bay cohort and 10 phases as C3; >=7-day and >=1-day windows; no retuning
status: Additional diagnostic controls declared before the new development check; no alteration to the original primary selection conditions.
